senses.gloss: --a tree of six rasas in the हैरण्वत (हिरण्- vata) country. Br. II. १५. ६८; IV. ३१. ५८; M. ११३. ६७; वा. ४५. 9.
--an elephant, son of अञ्जना. Br. III. 7. ३३९.
--an Apsaras. वा. ६९. 6.
--a son of जाम्बवान्. Br. III. 7. ३०३.

--one of the three forms of गृअहबलि; in addition to the procedure in the अयुतहोम, गरुड worship is added; fulfils all desires; if no specific benefits are wanted, it grants Brahmapada. M. ९३. 5, ८४-118; २३९. 1-१६.

(I)--a son of दशरथ and younger bro- ther of राम;
1: भा. IX. १०. 3; V. १९. 1 and 6.
took part in the लन्का expedition; respected the ब्रह्मणस् and elders; present at राम's coronation; father of Angada and Citraketu,
2: Ib. IX. १०. १९, ४१-7; ११. १२; Br. III. ३७. ३१; ६३. १८५; वा. ८८. १८४, १८७; १०८. २५; Vi. IV. 4. ८७, १०४.
whose cities were Kora- यण and Candracakra, near the हिमालयस्; created with राम by ललिता, he killed मेघनाद in भण्डासुर war.
3: Br. IV. २९. ११४.

(I)--a daughter of the king of the Madras; heard of कृष्ण's glory from नारद and set her mind on [page३-110+ ४३] him. It was arranged that in a स्वयम्वर he, who hit a target (fish) correctly by looking at its reflection in the water below was to wed her. All tried in vain but कृष्ण succeeded and married her; when she was taken in a chariot, other kings attacked कृष्ण; he vanquished all of them, and reached द्वारका. Addressed द्रौपदी at length on her marriage;
1: भा. X. ५८. ५७; ८३. 6, १७-39; M. ४७. १३; वा. ९६. २३४; Vi. V. २८. 5.
sons, गात्रवत् and others.
2: Ib. V. ३२. 4.

(II)--a daughter of Duryodhana married by साम्ब in a स्वयम्वर। For this the Kurus like कर्ण and Duryodhana took him captive after a severe fight and threw him into prison. Afraid of बलराम's prowess, Duryodhana agreed to her marriage with साम्ब and sent a rich dowry. भा. X. ६८. 1-१२, ४३-51.
(III)--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 7.

(II)--a daughter of दक्ष
1: वा. १०. २५, ३४; ५५. ४३; Br. II. 9. ४९, ५८; २६. ४५.
and a wife of Dharma, and mother of सूनृता;
2: Br. II. ३६. ८८; वा. ६२. ७६; Vi. I. 7. २३, २८; 8-२१.
a mother goddess as मूल- प्रकृति or माया;
3: Br. IV. 7. ७२.
abode of, in the Meru.
4: Vi. II. 2. ४७.

(III)--a daughter of भृगु and ख्याती and sister of धाता and विधाता;
1: Vi. I. १०. 2.
gave Baladeva an ear-ring and a lotus garland at वृन्दावन.
2: Ib. V. २५. १६.

--in the कूर्म पुराण;
1: M. ५३. ४८.
the २३र्द् kalpa.
2: Ib. २९०. 8.
--mantras sacred to the goddess. Br. IV. ३८. 6.
--a goddess enshrined at भरताश्रम. M. १३. ४६.
--apparently a dramatic compo- sition of Bharata (s.v.) enacted in the presence of पुरू- ravas at Indra's command. M. २४. २८-9.
